changes.comment: Adds a smoke test. A shared ESLint flat config is loaded by every consumer at lint time, so a config that throws on import or resolves to something ESLint cannot read breaks linting everywhere at once, and nothing here could catch that: the package ships one file and had no test script, which `rush test` skipped silently. The test asserts the config loads, is a non-empty array of objects, and declares at least one rule. It is dependency-free on purpose, since adding a test runner and a coverage provider to a one-file package costs more than it returns, and `files` keeps it out of the tarball.
